initial-dialogue.speaker: Dernu
initial-dialogue.text: A human? Can we eat it?

initial-dialogue.speaker: Derni
initial-dialogue.text: No, you rock brain! Humans are our friends!

initial-dialogue.speaker: Miodvetnir
initial-dialogue.text: Not sure if I would call them our friends... Not enemies either, of course.

initial-dialogue.speaker: Dernu
initial-dialogue.text: Not like the trolls. We hate trolls.

initial-dialogue.player: Excuse me, I just want to-

initial-dialogue.speaker: Dernu
initial-dialogue.text: Except discovering that your pickaxe's gone blunt just as you-

initial-dialogue.speaker: Miodvetnir
initial-dialogue.text: Why, hello, yes, what is it?

initial-dialogue.player: I er... well, who are you?

initial-dialogue.speaker: Miodvetnir
initial-dialogue.text: And I'm Miodvetnir. These are my brothers. And who might you be?

initial-dialogue.speaker: Dernu
initial-dialogue.text: I say, we don't get to see a hummon down here very often!

initial-dialogue.speaker: Miodvetnir
initial-dialogue.text: It's a human, you metal head! You should pay more attention!

initial-dialogue.player: So, can I ask you dwarves a few questions?

initial-dialogue.speaker: Miodvetnir
initial-dialogue.text: Of course, we love answering questions!

initial-dialogue.speaker: Dernu
initial-dialogue.text: We're very good at answering questions!
Continues with the below dialogue options

subsequent-dialogue.speaker: Derni
subsequent-dialogue.text: Or were you just stopping by for a chat?

subsequent-dialogue.player: Just stopping by for a chat.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Oh, you don't know?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: [He/She] doesn't know?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: [He/She] doesn't know!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: It is our glorious city!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: The grand city of the dwarves!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Sparkling jewel of the mountain!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Keldagrim, our home!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Oh no, we can't do that.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: We're far too busy.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: You have to keep busy, you see.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Always keep busy, is what our good father used to say.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Besides, there's been some weird going ons in the city.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Don't tell [him/her] that! None of [his/her] business!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Only fair if [he/she] wants to go into the city.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, they only just cleaned up the mess from the last little incident.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: So watch out if you ever do manage to travel to the city! Weird things could happen!

options.text: Any good spots to fish around here?

steps.player: Any good spots to fish around here?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Fish?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Fish?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What are fish?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: No fish around here.
After Fishing Contest:

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Say, you're the Fishing Champion, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That must be why you were talking about fish then...

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What are fish?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: But this water here, you see, it comes dripping down from above.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Molten snow, you see.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What are fish?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Oh, they're these small wriggly things that live in the water.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: But they're not all small! Some can be large!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: And they don't breathe air.
After Fishing Contest:

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: But [player name] could tell you all about it! After all, [he's/she's] the Fishing Champion!

options.text: What are these mines used for?

steps.player: What are these mines used for?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: What does it look like they're used for?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Isn't it obvious?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: For mining of course!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: These mines are actually the territory of one of the eight major companies of the mining Consortium.
Before The Giant Dwarf:

steps.player: Mining companies? Where are they at then?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Oh, they all have their headquarters in the city.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: First floor of the palace.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: No need to give [him/her] directions.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: We haul all our goods to the city by ship, you see.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Since the mine carts don't come here.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: But because the river goes right to the city, this is just as easy.

options.text: Can you help me with this rock?

steps.player: Can you help me with this rock down in the mines?
It seems to be unbreakable. I need to know why.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Say, is that Dondakan's rock?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: That big unbreakable rock?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That's what [he/she] said, isn't? Pay more attention!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Oh, you're not going to get through there I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: It's unbreakable, you see.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Dondakan's been there for...

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: How long would you say he's been there, Miotvednir?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Eighteen years, Derni, and not a year shorter!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: That's some dedication!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: But look at what it got him.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Nothing, that's what.

options.text: What material would break that rock?

steps.player: What material would break that rock? You know, the impenetrable one?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Well... have you tried a rune pickaxe?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: An adamantite tool?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What about a bronze pickaxe?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: A bronze pickaxe??

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: What good would that do?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Well, you never know...

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Don't you think that's the first thing they tried?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Hey, it was just a suggestion!

options.text: Do you know anyone named Rolad?

steps.player: Do you know anyone named Rolad? Some kind of a dwarven scholar?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Sorry, doesn't ring a bell.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, I know Rolad!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Oh, stop winding up the human, Dernu!

steps.player: Do you know where he is right now?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: No idea, why?

options.text: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!

steps.player: Dondakan wants to shoot me out of a cannon!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Oh dear!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: How awful!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That's terrible!

steps.player: He thinks I'm actually going to fly through it and land on the other side.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That sounds a bit daft.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: How would that work?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: I think you're going to hurt your head.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Old Dondakan might have finally lost it.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: He was always obsessed with that rock.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: And gold.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Right, and gold.

options.text: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?

steps.player: Any tips on how to defeat an evil demon?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: An evil demon, you say?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: I'd run away if I ever ran into an evil demon.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Don't be such a coward, Dernu!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Well, what would you do then?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: I don't know, I've never encountered an evil demon.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: I once met a good demon though.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, what did he say?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: He gave me a puzzle box and then went off again.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: I think you must have had too much dwarven stout in you.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Could be, could be, but there's no telling, is there?

options.text: I defeated the spirit of the rock!
options.condition: First time after Between a Rock...:

steps.player: I defeated the spirit of the rock!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: That's amazing!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That's fantastic!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What rock was that again?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Pay attention for once, Dernu! It's Dondakan's rock!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: That's quite impressive, Player. How did you manage to do that?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her/their] great might of course!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Or vast magical skills!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: No, you're more a ranger, aren't you Player?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Anyway, this calls for a celebration.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, we should go down into Keldagrim to celebrate.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Tonight, of course, not now. We're on duty now.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Right... and I'm sure traffic here will pick up soon with that rock broken.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: I heard there's vast amount of gold inside!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: The company is going to be rich!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Now don't you go and discuss company business in front of this human, Dernu.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Right. Let's get back to work.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Anything else you wanted, Player?

options.text: I need some help with this statue...

steps.player: I need some help with this statue... King Alvis' statue, to be precise.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, what's the problem then?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: It was knocked down, remember? Parts of it nearly landed on our heads?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: A terrible noise it made too!
Before helping Blasidar:
While helping Blasidar:

steps.player: This sculptor has got me looking for a lot of items, you see.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Items eh?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: We love items.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Can't get enough of them.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: I got this puzzle box once, you know.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Oh, not that story again.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: You have told that story before, Dernu.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Well forget about it then. I'll shut up if you don't want to hear about it.
After helping Blasidar:

steps.player: Well, the sculptor only needs to build the head now. But I need to get the Consortium to help me with that.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: The Consortium, you say?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: You're going to talk to the Consortium?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: My, you're certainly moving up in the dwarven world, aren't you?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: What do you need us for then?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: We are but simple dwarves.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Especially you, Dernu.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Now now, Derni, there was no need for that.

options.text: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!
options.condition: First time after The Giant Dwarf:

steps.player: I have rebuilt the statue for the [company name]!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: What, really?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she/they]?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: And didn't you see Blasidar working on the statue?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Oh yes, he was out there for quite a while.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: That must have been a huge task.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Nothing's too difficult for old Blasidar.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: He truly is a master builder.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: We can all take an example to his hard work and dedication.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Speaking of, shouldn't we get back to work ourselves?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Quite right. Anything else you wanted, Player?

options.text: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?
options.condition: During Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf:

steps.player: Do you know about this drunken dwarf...?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Drunken dwarf?

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Yeah, we know a drunken dwarf!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: In fact we know plenty!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: There's this one really annoying dwarf though, he sometimes throws rocks at me for no reason.

steps.player: The one I mean is his relative, living in the northeast of Keldagrim. I wonder if you could help me with him.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Ah yes, him.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Such a sad case, poor fellow.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Who is he?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Don't you know anything?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Now now, there's no reason to get angry.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: I suppose you're right. Well, he's a drunk dwarf that talks about kebabs a lot.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Has some pretty odd tales to tell too.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: And I understand he's the relative of that dwarf I mentioned earlier.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: I hope that helped, Player?

options.text: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!
options.condition: First time after Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf:

steps.player: I have this unforgettable tale to tell you!

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: A tale!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: We love tales!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: We live for tales!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Like, there was this one time when I lost my spanner in the mines...

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Player wants to tell a tale!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: But my spanner... it's a very interesting tale you know.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: I think we've heard it before.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: It was pretty forgettable.

steps.player: Excuse me, do you want to hear my tale or not?

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: Happy to.

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Would love to hear it.

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: As long as it's better than my spanner story.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: So, what's your tale like?

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Must have been pretty forgettable as well then.

steps.player: I must be off now, thanks for the chat.

steps.speaker: Miodvetnir
steps.text: No problem!

steps.speaker: Dernu
steps.text: Glad to be of service!

steps.speaker: Derni
steps.text: Come back any time!
